subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be accepted as a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into the existing threading config, or consolidated with the broader configurable thread-session work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96843?
rationale: This changes public Google Chat account configuration and reopens a message-delivery path that was previously disabled after API failures, so automation should not choose the permanent config API or upgrade stance.

options.title: Choose one config API before merge
options.body: Decide the canonical Google Chat DM threading control, then require the PR to update exported types, metadata, docs, and real Google Chat proof before landing.

options.title: Accept separate `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Keep this PR's new account key, but treat it as a public config addition and require the complete contract plus upgrade and live delivery evidence.

options.title: Pause for broader thread-session work
options.body: Hold or close this PR in favor of resolving the overlapping configurable DM thread-session design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96843.

recommendation.title: Choose one config API before merge
recommendation.body: Decide the canonical Google Chat DM threading control, then require the PR to update exported types, metadata, docs, and real Google Chat proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate for the product/API decision because they verified the prior DM thread suppression and have adjacent Google Chat threading history.
